<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Optimized Production Authentication System
 * Follows PSR-12 standards, secure by design, high performance
 * Audit-friendly, maintainable, and compliant with OWASP guidelines
 */
final class Authentication
{
    // JWT Configuration - use environment variables in production
    private const JWT_SECRET_ENV = 'AUTH_JWT_SECRET';
    private const JWT_EXPIRY_SECONDS = 3600; // 1 hour
    private const JWT_ALGORITHM = 'HS256';

    // Password hashing config
    private const PASSWORD_ALGO = PASSWORD_DEFAULT;
    private const PASSWORD_COST = 12;

    // Session security config
    private const SESSION_HTTP_ONLY = true;
    private const SESSION_SECURE = true;
    private const SESSION_SAME_SITE = 'Strict';

    /**
     * Singleton instance to avoid redundant initialization
     */
    private static ?self $instance = null;

    private string $jwtSecret;

    /**
     * Private constructor to enforce singleton pattern
     * @throws RuntimeException if JWT secret is missing
     */
    private function __construct()
    {
        $secret = getenv(self::JWT_SECRET_ENV);
        if (!$secret || strlen($secret) < 32) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Valid JWT secret not found in environment');
        }
        $this->jwtSecret = $secret;

        // Initialize secure session only once
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            $this->initSecureSession();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get singleton instance
     */
    public static function getInstance(): self
    {
        if (self::$instance === null) {
            self::$instance = new self();
        }
        return self::$instance;
    }

    /**
     * Hash password securely for storage
     */
    public function hashPassword(string $plainPassword): string
    {
        return password_hash($plainPassword, self::PASSWORD_ALGO, ['cost' => self::PASSWORD_COST]);
    }

    /**
     * Verify password against stored hash
     * Automatically rehashes if password needs upgrade
     */
    public function verifyPassword(string $plainPassword, string $storedHash, ?string &$newHash = null): bool
    {
        $valid = password_verify($plainPassword, $storedHash);
        if ($valid && password_needs_rehash($storedHash, self::PASSWORD_ALGO, ['cost' => self::PASSWORD_COST])) {
            $newHash = $this->hashPassword($plainPassword);
        }
        return $valid;
    }

    /**
     * Generate stateless JWT token for authenticated user
     */
    public function generateJwt(int $userId, array $additionalClaims = []): string
    {
        $now = time();
        $header = json_encode([
            'typ' => 'JWT',
            'alg' => self::JWT_ALGORITHM
        ], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        $payload = json_encode(array_merge([
            'iss' => getenv('APP_DOMAIN') ?: 'localhost',
            'sub' => $userId,
            'iat' => $now,
            'exp' => $now + self::JWT_EXPIRY_SECONDS,
            'nbf' => $now
        ], $additionalClaims), JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        $base64Header = $this->base64UrlEncode($header);
        $base64Payload = $this->base64UrlEncode($payload);
        $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', "$base64Header.$base64Payload", $this->jwtSecret, true);
        $base64Signature = $this->base64UrlEncode($signature);

        return "$base64Header.$base64Payload.$base64Signature";
    }

    /**
     * Validate JWT token and return payload if valid
     */
    public function validateJwt(string $token): ?array
    {
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            return null;
        }

        [$header64, $payload64, $signature64] = $parts;

        $header = json_decode($this->base64UrlDecode($header64), true);
        if (!$header || ($header['alg'] ?? '') !== self::JWT_ALGORITHM) {
            return null;
        }

        $signature = $this->base64UrlDecode($signature64);
        $validSignature = hash_hmac('sha256', "$header64.$payload64", $this->jwtSecret, true);
        if (!hash_equals($validSignature, $signature)) {
            return null;
        }

        $payload = json_decode($this->base64UrlDecode($payload64), true);
        if (!$payload || ($payload['exp'] ?? 0) < time() || ($payload['nbf'] ?? time()) > time()) {
            return null;
        }

        return $payload;
    }

    /**
     * Initialize secure session settings
     */
    private function initSecureSession(): void
    {
        session_set_cookie_params([
            'lifetime' => 0,
            'path' => '/',
            'domain' => getenv('APP_DOMAIN') ?: '',
            'secure' => self::SESSION_SECURE && (getenv('APP_ENV') !== 'development'),
            'httponly' => self::SESSION_HTTP_ONLY,
            'samesite' => self::SESSION_SAME_SITE
        ]);
        session_start();
        session_regenerate_id(true); // Prevent session fixation
    }

    /**
     * Base64 URL safe encoding
     */
    private function base64UrlEncode(string $data): string
    {
        return rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($data), '+/', '-_'), '=');
    }

    /**
     * Base64 URL safe decoding
     */
    private function base64UrlDecode(string $data): string
    {
        $padding = strlen($data) % 4;
        if ($padding) {
            $data .= str_repeat('=', 4 - $padding);
        }
        return base64_decode(strtr($data, '-_', '+/'));
    }

    /**
     * Prevent cloning of singleton
     */
    private function __clone() {}

    /**
     * Prevent unserialization of singleton
     */
    public function __wakeup()
    {
        throw new RuntimeException("Cannot unserialize singleton");
    }
}

// Example usage (remove or move to controller layer in production)
if (getenv('APP_ENV') === 'development') {
    $auth = Authentication::getInstance();
    
    // Hash password example
    $hash = $auth->hashPassword('SecureUserPass123!');
    
    // Verify and rehash example
    $newHash = null;
    $isValid = $auth->verifyPassword('SecureUserPass123!', $hash, $newHash);
    
    // Generate JWT example
    $token = $auth->generateJwt(123, ['role' => 'user', 'email' => 'user@example.com']);
    
    // Validate JWT example
    $payload = $auth->validateJwt($token);
}
?>
